# Fervidus
An incredibly hot planet, seas of lava cutting into the basalt crust.
The surface has an immensely high concentration of most conventional metals, to the point where even a small scale mining operation could supply an entire faction for years. Atempts at deeper surveys failed due to the immensely high heat causing equipment failure.
The atmosphere is almost entirely poisonous, being concentrated BZ gas with a slight amount of ammonia.
One of the primary reasons that long-term settlements have been deemed impossible, apart from the heat, is due to the lava rivers. Unlike most molten planets, the lava is made of a mix of non-fissile, but still highly radioactive material.
## Since the Collapse
Fervidus is still the hottest world in the system: ash wastes, lava crust and tar pools under a sky of falling ash. The [textlink="Ashfall Reavers" link="WFLoreReavers"] took their name from its ash belts.
Its wildlife was not native. Laser raptors are a Syndicate weapons line gone feral, bred from stock aboard the battle group that died in this sector. Ash golems and cinder slimes came later, and nobody can say from where. Ash hawks ride the heat and stoop on anyone walking alone.
